remedies.action: Investigate first: audit the pages engines cite for the unbranded prompts and identify which independent lists, reviews and comparisons Kasparro could legitimately be covered in; then pursue inclusion in those sources with accurate, verifiable information.
remedies.effort: Medium to high (outreach and content over weeks; audit itself about 1 day).
remedies.expected_benefit: Creates the sources engines would need before Kasparro can appear in discovery answers.
remedies.priority_rationale: Largest audience: unbranded questions are where new buyers form shortlists, and the gap is total.
remedies.problem: Kasparro does not enter the consideration set for vendor-neutral discovery questions.
remedies.uncertainty: High. Inclusion is not guaranteed and engines differ in retrieval; one snapshot cannot show cause.
remedies.validation: Re-run the same 25 unbranded prompts on all three engines (same location/language settings) and track unbranded mention rate against the 0-baseline, plus the count of cited pages that mention Kasparro.

remedies.action: Make the entity unambiguous: consistent name ('Kasparro', domain kasparro.com) across the site, Organization structured data with sameAs links to official profiles, and an About page stating what Kasparro is in plain text. Align naming on LinkedIn and job posts ('Kasparro AI' vs 'Kasparro').
remedies.expected_benefit: Fewer answers about the wrong product on commercial questions (pricing, cancellation, signup).
remedies.priority_rationale: Cheapest to fix and it corrupts branded answers on commercial questions.
remedies.problem: Engines resolve 'Kasparro' to Kaspr or fail to identify it, so even branded answers can be about the wrong company.
remedies.uncertainty: Medium. Name similarity may persist in retrieval; Google guidance says structured data must match visible content and guarantees nothing.
remedies.validation: Re-run the 25 branded prompts; compare entity-confusion count and the deterministic 'Kaspr' count with this run.

remedies.action: Publish verifiable facts buyers ask about (pricing, diagnostic scope, onboarding time, cancellation terms, methodology) as crawlable text on kasparro.com, and only cite outcomes that have evidence. Check robots/crawler access for OAI-SearchBot and Googlebot on those pages.
remedies.expected_benefit: Engines can cite first-party facts instead of job posts or 'no information found'.
remedies.priority_rationale: Affects buyers already considering Kasparro; depends partly on evidence Kasparro may not have yet.
remedies.problem: Direct questions get hedged or unfavourable answers backed mostly by job listings.
remedies.uncertainty: Medium. First-party pages establish what Kasparro says, not independent proof; doubts about results may remain.
remedies.validation: Re-run branded prompts; track negative rate, owned-citation rate and the share of Kasparro-related citations that are kasparro.com pages rather than job listings.
